crossed.name: Sternocleidomastoid & scalenes
crossed.pattern: Upper crossed · anterior · tight, facilitated (type I postural) → stretch
crossed.exercise: Stretch, seated: the opposite hand pins the clavicle; tuck the chin and glide the head straight back, side-bend away from the tight side, then rotate either way into the pull. Hold 15-20 s, both sides

crossed.name: Pectoralis major (upper fibers) & pectoralis minor
crossed.pattern: Upper crossed · anterior · tight, facilitated (type I postural) → stretch
crossed.exercise: Stretch: hands on a door frame at about nose height, elbows near 90°, lean the chest forward through the doorway. Hold 30-45 s, then repeat with the hands 6 inches higher

crossed.name: Upper trapezius
crossed.pattern: Upper crossed · posterior · tight, facilitated (type I postural) → stretch
crossed.exercise: Stretch: the opposite hand stabilizes the clavicle and 1st rib; flex the neck, side-bend AWAY and rotate TOWARD the tight side, into the barrier. Hold 15-20 s, both sides

crossed.name: Levator scapulae
crossed.pattern: Upper crossed · posterior · tight, facilitated (type I postural) → stretch
crossed.exercise: Stretch: grip the edge of the chair or bed to anchor the shoulder blade on the tight side; flex, side-bend and rotate the head AWAY from it, into the barrier - a stretch, not pain. Hold 15-20 s

crossed.name: Cervical erector spinae
crossed.pattern: Upper crossed · posterior · tight, facilitated (type I postural) → stretch
crossed.exercise: Stretched by the supine 'double chin' tuck - the same drill that strengthens the weak group at the front of the neck

crossed.name: Deep cervical flexors
crossed.pattern: Upper crossed · anterior · weak, inhibited (type II phasic) → strengthen
crossed.exercise: Strengthen: tuck the chin into a 'double chin' lying on a thin towel, or standing against a wall with a tennis ball under the chin as a cue - no head lift

crossed.name: Middle/lower trapezius & rhomboids
crossed.pattern: Upper crossed · posterior · weak, inhibited (type II phasic) → strengthen
crossed.exercise: Strengthen: back against a wall, elbows at shoulder height and bent 90°, rotate the forearms back to touch the wrists to the wall (hold 5 s, 8-20 reps); or prone, thumbs up, lift toward the ceiling

crossed.name: Latissimus dorsi
crossed.pattern: Upper crossed · posterior · weak, inhibited (type II phasic) → strengthen
crossed.exercise: Strengthen: back to the wall, start with both arms reaching straight overhead, then pull them down like a pull-down until the upper arms reach shoulder level, elbows bent 90°; repeat

crossed.name: Serratus anterior
crossed.pattern: Upper crossed · posterior · weak, inhibited (type II phasic) → strengthen

crossed.name: Iliopsoas
crossed.pattern: Lower crossed · anterior · tight, facilitated (type I postural) → stretch
crossed.exercise: Stretch: half-kneel with the opposite foot well forward (knee over ankle), shoulders back, and shift the pelvis forward; or lie supine at the bed's edge hugging one knee while the other leg hangs off. Hold 30-60 s

crossed.name: Rectus femoris
crossed.pattern: Lower crossed · anterior · tight, facilitated (type I postural) → stretch
crossed.exercise: Stretch: standing with one hand on the wall, pull the heel up toward the buttock (or rest the foot on a chair behind you if that is too hard). Hold 30-60 s

crossed.name: Adductor brevis
crossed.pattern: Lower crossed · anterior · tight, facilitated (type I postural) → stretch
crossed.exercise: Stretch: wide side lunge in the coronal plane - one knee bent, the other leg straight - shifting weight sideways until the groin pulls. Hold 30-60 s

crossed.name: Quadratus lumborum
crossed.pattern: Lower crossed · posterior · tight, facilitated (type I postural) → stretch
crossed.exercise: Stretch: seated on a bed with feet planted, side-bend the trunk to one side and hold up to 2 min; or stand, reach both arms overhead and lean to one side without leaning forward, 30-60 s

crossed.name: Thoracolumbar erector spinae
crossed.pattern: Lower crossed · posterior · tight, facilitated (type I postural) → stretch
crossed.exercise: Stretch into trunk flexion: lie supine and hug both knees to the chest, or kneel, reach the arms forward and sit the buttocks back onto the heels. Hold 30-60 s

crossed.name: Hamstrings
crossed.pattern: Lower crossed · posterior · tight, facilitated (type I postural) → stretch
crossed.exercise: Stretch: sit on the edge of a solid chair, one leg straight and one bent, hands on the bent knee, and lean toward the straight knee - felt mid-muscle, not at the sit bone or behind the knee. Hold ~45 s

crossed.name: Piriformis
crossed.pattern: Lower crossed · posterior · tight, facilitated (type I postural) → stretch
crossed.exercise: Stretch: seated, cross the affected ankle over the opposite thigh and lean forward with a straight back, head turned toward the crossed leg; or supine, pull the uncrossed thigh to the chest. Hold 30-60 s

crossed.name: Gastrocnemius-soleus complex
crossed.pattern: Lower crossed · posterior · tight, facilitated (type I postural) → stretch
crossed.exercise: Stretch: holding a counter, stand with the balls of the feet up on a 2x4 and the heels on the floor, knees straight. Hold 1-2 min

crossed.name: Rectus abdominis (abdominals)
crossed.pattern: Lower crossed · anterior · weak, inhibited (type II phasic) → strengthen
crossed.exercise: Strengthen: supine curl-up, lifting the head and upper back and reaching toward the knees; then a posterior pelvic tilt on exhalation for the lower fibers. 8-15 reps

crossed.name: Vastus lateralis, medialis & intermedius
crossed.pattern: Lower crossed · anterior · weak, inhibited (type II phasic) → strengthen
crossed.exercise: Strengthen: step up onto a bench straightening the knee, or stand on a step and bend that knee to lower the other heel and tap the floor (8-15 reps); or slide down a wall to a 90° squat with weight on the heels

crossed.name: Tibialis anterior
crossed.pattern: Lower crossed · anterior · weak, inhibited (type II phasic) → strengthen
crossed.exercise: Strengthen: holding a counter, rock back onto the heels and lift the toes as high as possible. 8-20 reps

crossed.name: Gluteus maximus
crossed.pattern: Lower crossed · posterior · weak, inhibited (type II phasic) → strengthen
crossed.exercise: Strengthen: hip extension - standing at a counter, swing the straight leg back without leaning forward, or lie prone and lift the straight leg. 12-15 reps each side

crossed.name: Gluteus medius & minimus
crossed.pattern: Lower crossed · posterior · weak, inhibited (type II phasic) → strengthen
crossed.exercise: Strengthen: side-lying straight-leg hip abduction to 30-40° with the top hand in front to stop rolling back; or stand on a step, standing knee locked straight, and hike the opposite hip. 8-15 reps
